career_ladder.note: Constables form the core frontline law enforcement personnel of Rajasthan Police under the Rajasthan Police Subordinate Service Rules, 1989. They serve across District Executive Police, Rajasthan Armed Constabulary (RAC), State Special Branch (CID), Police Telecommunications, and the Mewar Bhil Corps (MBC).

exam_scheme.note: Under the Rajasthan Police Subordinate Service Rules 1989 and Standing Order No. 2305, selection comprises four sequential stages: Physical Efficiency Test (PET) & Physical Standard Test (PST), Computer Based Written Examination (CBT), Skill / Proficiency Test (for Driver, Band, and Mounted roles), and Document Verification & Medical Examination. The CBT carries 150 marks with 0.25 (1/4th) negative marking per wrong answer.

financial_package.note: Constables are placed in Pay Matrix Level L-5 (Pay Band ₹5,200–₹20,200 with Grade Pay ₹2,400) under the Rajasthan Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2017. During the mandatory two-year probation period in Rajasthan, a fixed trainee remuneration of ₹14,600 per month is paid. Upon successful completion of probation, regular entry basic pay of ₹20,800 is drawn in Level L-5.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Rajasthan Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules 2017 Schedule Level L-5
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level L-5 entry basic pay of ₹20,800 at 58% DA (₹12,064 effective 01.07.2025), HRA (9% to 18%: ₹1,872 to ₹3,744), uniform maintenance allowance, washing allowance, ration money subsidy, net of State Insurance, General Provident Fund, and RGHS deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised semi-annually per Rajasthan Finance Department orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized by posting zone (Class Y and Z cities)
Uniform washing allowance, equipment maintenance grant, and annual kit replacement
Subsidized police mess facilities, ration money allowance, and police welfare funds
Cashless medical facility under Rajasthan Government Health Scheme (RGHS)
Defined pension coverage under restored Old Pension Scheme (OPS)
